_comment: Ladder rung 5 — the CARRY hypothesis, and the one the n=300 result forces.
The extra near-null is n-INVARIANT: ev 9.78e-06 at 50 stations and 8.97e-06 at
300, against lambda_max 1.03e+05 and 9.13e+04.  Six times the stations added NO
information to it, which is the signature of a true GAUGE rather than a weak
direction -- consistent with the mechanism: with FLOAT ambiguities a
satellite-common L2W phase bias is exactly absorbable by the L2W ambiguities, and
more stations bring more ambiguities as well as more data.
So the field's 303-station arm cannot be emitting because of its station count.
It differs from this posture by a large armed set, and the member that bears
directly on this degeneracy is the CARRY: network.carry_invariant time-links the
DD chord basis across epochs, so the ambiguities are no longer free to absorb the
bias.  If that is the lever, this rung emits at DEFAULT tolerance and the finding
is that the W6+SH slice is observable through its CARRY, not through its data.
carry_invariant_pd_safe rides along because the PD-safe fold is field-validated
and the un-guarded fold is not (PD gate 0% vs 87.7%).

carry_invariant is REFUSED by the loader without phase_datum_eq34 (the DD cycle basis is defined only on the eq34 chain datum: RPB split + spanning tree supply the invariant DDs), so this rung is the PAIR.  Rung 2 tested eq34 ALONE and did not emit, which is what makes the pair the clean test of the carry rather than of the datum.
